'''Reebo Keen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male,]] who moved to [[Ostor]] and became one of the leaders of the group of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] there. Earlier in his life, he was an adventurer and discovered two [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. A few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] ended which resulted the birth of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Imperials launched a military offensive to suppress the influence of the Separatists on Ostor. Keen and the other Separatist leaders helped set up a defense strategy. This allowed the Separatist general [[Atticus Farstar]] to almost completely wipe out the first wave of Imperial forces. However, the defense did not stand up to a second wave of attacks, leading to Keen and the other leaders perishing during the battle.
